pages.text: A muffin comes on more slowly than a draw. Tea, joints and smoking tools also contribute to the same profile. Read $(l:psychedelicraft:preparations/cannabis)the preparation recipes$(/l) to choose how you want to serve it.

pages.title: Perception & Pace
pages.text: Expect slower movement and mining as intensity rises, along with color, movement and contextual hallucinations. At high intensity, ordinary chat can pick up extra words.
